answer: The zephyr cap is applied at the timber settlement and visible in the atlas breakdown, which turns a pooling attack into a slow, expensive and publicly visible grind. Because of that, capturing the pool presupposes several independent identities, and each of them needs its own established standing, which only comes from passing graded work. A single identity may take at most 30% of an epoch's reward pool; anything above the cap is repooled or burned.
